apiKey.title: Connect {{name}}
apiKey.description: Paste your {{name}} API key. Houston keeps it safe and uses it for your chats.
apiKey.label: API key
apiKey.endpointHelp: The endpoint URL from your resource in the Azure portal. Houston calls the deployment named exactly like the model, so name your deployments after the model (for example "gpt-5.5").
apiKey.endpointRequired: Enter your endpoint URL first. It starts with https:// and comes from your resource in the Azure portal.

guide.title: How to get your key
guide.nvidia1: Open the NVIDIA key page with the button above and sign in, or create a free account.
guide.nvidia2: Click "Generate Personal Key" and under "Services Included" check "Public API Endpoints".
guide.nvidia3: Copy the key that starts with "nvapi-" and paste it below.
guide.bedrock1: Open the Bedrock API keys page with the button above and choose "Long-term API keys".
guide.bedrock2: Click "Generate long-term API keys". The key value is shown only once, so copy it right away.
guide.bedrock3: Paste the key value below. It starts with "ABSK". The name shown in the list ("BedrockAPIKey-...") is not the key.
guide.azure1: In the Azure portal, open your Azure OpenAI (or Foundry) resource and go to "Keys and endpoint".
guide.azure2: Copy one of the two keys and the endpoint URL.
guide.azure3: Deploy the models you want to use, each named exactly like the model (for example "gpt-5.5"), then paste the endpoint and key here.

apiKey.errorInvalidKey: {{name}} didn't accept this key. Check it and paste it again.
apiKey.errorKeyRestricted: This key is blocked by settings in your {{name}} account. Create a new key without restrictions using the button above, then paste it here.
apiKey.errorNvidiaAccountGated: Your key is valid, but NVIDIA isn't serving any chat models to your account right now. Make sure your key is a Personal Key from org.ngc.nvidia.com with "Public API Endpoints" under Services Included. If it still fails, ask NVIDIA support to enable model access for your account.
apiKey.errorBedrockInvalidKey: Amazon Bedrock didn't accept this key. Make sure you pasted the key value (it starts with "ABSK"), not its name from the list ("BedrockAPIKey-..."). AWS shows the value only once, so generate a new key if you no longer have it.
apiKey.errorProviderUnavailable: We couldn't reach {{name}} to check your key, so nothing was saved. Please try again in a moment.
apiKey.errorOrgAdminRequired: Only an owner or admin can connect AI for the organization. Ask one of them to set it up, or to add you to an agent so you can connect your own key.
